messages:
alex: Quick async standup — SDKs / quickstarts / sample app status. What I did: pushed edits to python quickstart (added auth snippet + troubleshooting), filed PR #412 for the redwood-sample-shop readme. Blockers: CI flaking on macOS runners for wheel build, still repro locally on M1. Today: triage CI, ping infra, and finalize the sampleapp packaging notes.

maria: Thanks — saw the PR. Quick note: the python auth snippet needs a tiny scope change (`scope: inference.read`) otherwise examples fail on token-limited accounts. Leaving an inline comment.

alex: @maria good catch, updating now. Also added a short troubleshooting FAQ for token errors — want to link that from the quickstart.

sam: FYI I re-ran the macOS CI job and got the same wheel error: `ERROR: invalid wheel filename` coming from our build script when numpy pinned to 1.25.0. Reverting numpy to 1.24 fixes it. Might be faster to pin in CI until upstream resolves.

priya: Can we avoid pinning long-term? If sampleapp pins old numpy, downstream users hit conflicts. Maybe add a conditional step in CI that builds with both 1.24 and 1.25 and only uploads the 1.24 artifact for now.

alex: Good idea. @sam can you prototype that matrix in `.github/workflows/sample-build.yml`? Keep artifact names explicit e.g., `redwood-sample-shop-macos-x86_64.whl` and `-arm64.whl`.

sam: Yep, can do. Will push a matrix job and tag you in the PR. ETA end of day.

maria: Mini docs ask — the quickstart has a code block showing streaming with `for chunk in stream:`. Can we add an example of handling partial JSON outputs and mention `strict=False` for the parser? People hit json decode errors in the wild.

priya: Also saw two small typos in the sampleapp README (env var names). I'll open a doc PR for those.

alex: Blocker for me: need a reviewer for doc PR #413 (quickstarts restructure). @maria or @priya can you take a look today? It's mostly reordering headings and adding anchors for the console walkthrough.

maria: I can review after standup, will prioritize the anchors and the streaming example.

alex: Thanks. Logistics: tagging the docs release checklist — we want these updates in the next patch release (docs-only) on Thursday. If CI matrix fixes land today, we can cut the branch tomorrow.

sam: devex-bot just reported a flaky test: `tests/test_samples::test_sample_startup` — failing intermittently with timeout 45s. I'll file a flaky ticket if I repro locally.

devex-bot: [automated] New issue created: DEVEX-678 flaky sample startup timeout. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/678

alex: Final — small demo ask: @priya can you prepare a 5-min snippet for next week's office hours showing how to boot the sampleapp with Dedicated creds? Nothing fancy, just env setup + run command.

priya: Yep — will add slides and a one-liner script in `scripts/run_demo.sh`.

alex: Cool, that's it. If anyone hits an urgent blocker ping #eng-oncall as backup. :thumbsup:
